Definition: from G2910; overhanging, i.e. a precipice:--steep place.
BiblicalUsage: The steep place is the cliff the swine ran down, and all three Gospels tell it the same way: in Matthew 8:32, Mark 5:13, and Luke 8:33 the herd runs violently down a steep place into the sea and perishes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this steep place shows what a legion of demons does to whatever it gets hold of: it drives it headlong to destruction, and only Jesus stands between a man and that cliff.
